decisions: The new equity_backfill planner delegates session coverage classification, terminal-state filtering, item grouping, and queue message construction to T025/T036 lake.equity_catchup rather than duplicating it.

Each plan reads the catalog again, so successful complete or terminal-empty rows are omitted on a resumed plan without a process-local cursor. Newest session date is primary; lower liquidity rank, ranked-before-unranked status, and canonical symbol provide deterministic tie-breaks.

max_items bounds one dispatch batch and has_more reports omitted actionable candidates. Universe maximum_liquidity_rank is applied per data type, allowing a symbol to remain queued for an eligible data type.

Queue sending uses the injected T027 QueueSender through enqueue_equity_catch_up. Delivery handling remains the injected T035 QueueWorker QueueHandler boundary; no provider, Azure, credential, or network client is created by the planner.
limitations: Liquidity ranks are caller-supplied metadata because the repository has no local liquidity-ranking provider or catalog table.
No live Azure, provider, credentials, network access, or MyPy run was used.
